facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 27 April 2026 a planned assurance activity of PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the in-service inspection of pressure equipment not effective.
